2. Subscriber Representations and Warranties
By executing this Subscription Agreement, the Subscriber represents and warrants
to the Fund and the General Partner that:
The Subscriber has received and carefully reviewed the Memorandum, including
the Risk Factors, Conflicts of Interest, and Certain U.S. Federal Income Tax
Considerations sections, and has had the opportunity to ask questions of, and
receive answers from, the General Partner concerning the terms and conditions of
this offering.
The Subscriber is acquiring the Interest for its own account, for investment
purposes only, and not with a view toward resale or distribution.
The Subscriber has such knowledge and experience in financial and business
matters that it is capable of evaluating the merits and risks of an investment in the
Fund, and is able to bear the economic risk of such investment, including the risk
of loss of its entire investment.
CONFIDENTIAL
The Subscriber is not relying on the Fund, the General Partner, or any of their
affiliates for tax, legal, or investment advice, and has consulted with its own
advisors to the extent it deems necessary.
The Subscriber understands that the Interests have not been registered under the
Securities Act or any state securities laws, are being offered in reliance on an
exemption from registration, and are subject to significant restrictions on transfer
as described in the Memorandum and the Partnership Agreement.
The Subscriber understands and accepts the illiquid nature of an investment in the
Fund, including the 12-month lock-up period and the redemption terms (including
gating and suspension rights) described in the Memorandum.
The Subscriber understands that the Upfront Fee described in the Memorandum is
non-refundable under any circumstance and is not invested by the Fund.
The Subscriber understands that the General Partner's carried interest is
calculated without a preferred return or hurdle rate, such that the General Partner
participates in net profits from the first dollar of gain.
The Subscriber is not a “U.S. person” as defined in Rule 902(k) of Regulation S, is
purchasing its Interest in an offshore transaction, and is not purchasing for the
account or benefit of a U.S. person, as confirmed in the Regulation S Certification
below[, and, if required for the Fund's reliance on Section 3(c)(7) of the Investment
Company Act, a “qualified purchaser” as confirmed therein].
The Subscriber received no offer to purchase an Interest, and was not solicited,
while physically present in the United States, and the Subscriber's subscription
was not solicited by means of any “directed selling effort” in the United States as
defined in Regulation S.
The Subscriber understands that the Interests are subject to a one-year
distribution compliance period under Regulation S, during which the Subscriber
may not offer, sell, or transfer its Interest to a U.S. person or within the United
States except pursuant to registration under the Securities Act or another
available exemption.
All information provided by the Subscriber in this Subscription Agreement,
including the Regulation S Certification, is true, complete, and correct, and the
Subscriber agrees to notify the General Partner promptly if any such information
becomes inaccurate.
CONFIDENTIAL
3. Regulation S Certification
This offering is being conducted outside the United States in reliance on Regulation
S under the Securities Act. Interests may not be offered or sold to, or for the account
or benefit of, any “U.S. person,” as defined in Rule 902(k) of Regulation S. The
Subscriber must complete this Section 3 in full.
3A. Non-U.S. Person Certification
The Subscriber certifies that it is NOT a “U.S. person” under any of the following
categories defined in Rule 902(k) of Regulation S. A U.S. person includes, among
others:
A natural person resident in the United States.
A partnership or corporation organized or incorporated under the laws of the
United States.
An estate of which any executor or administrator is a U.S. person (other than an
estate governed by non-U.S. law and administered by a non-U.S. professional
fiduciary where a U.S. person co-executor or co-administrator has no investment
discretion and no U.S. beneficiary).
A trust of which any trustee is a U.S. person (other than certain trusts
administered by a non-U.S. professional fiduciary where the settlor is not a U.S.
person and no beneficiary is a U.S. person).
An agency or branch of a non-U.S. entity located in the United States.
A non-discretionary account or similar account (other than an estate or trust) held
by a dealer or other fiduciary for the benefit or account of a U.S. person.
A discretionary account or similar account (other than an estate or trust) held by a
dealer or other fiduciary organized, incorporated, or (if an individual) resident in
the United States.
A partnership or corporation organized or incorporated under the laws of a
jurisdiction other than the United States, if formed by a U.S. person principally for
the purpose of investing in securities not registered under the Securities Act,
unless organized or incorporated, and owned, by accredited investors who are not
natural persons, estates, or trusts.
I / we certify that none of the above categories apply, and I am / we are not a
U.S. person.

6. Anti-Money Laundering and OFAC
Representations
The Subscriber represents and warrants that:
The funds used to pay the Subscriber's Capital Commitment were not, and will not
be, derived from or related to any illegal activity, including money laundering or
terrorist financing.
The Subscriber is not, and is not acting on behalf of, any person or entity named on
the U.S. Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (“OFAC”) List of
Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons, or otherwise subject to U.S.
economic sanctions.
The Subscriber will promptly provide the General Partner or the Fund's
administrator with such information as they reasonably request from time to time
to verify the Subscriber's identity and source of funds and to comply with
applicable anti-money laundering and sanctions laws.
If the Subscriber is investing on behalf of or as agent for another person, the
Subscriber has verified the identity and source of funds of such other person
consistent with applicable law.
